questions.question: With what was the firstling of an ass to be redeemed?
questions.evidence: the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb

questions.question: How long was Moses there with the LORD on the mount?
questions.evidence: he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights

questions.question: What had happened to the skin of Moses' face when he came down from mount Sinai?
questions.evidence: the skin of his face shone

questions.question: What did Moses put on his face when he had done speaking with the people?
questions.evidence: he put a vail on his face

questions.question: What were the people not to kindle in their habitations on the sabbath day?
questions.evidence: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.

questions.question: What did the rulers bring for the ephod and the breastplate?
questions.evidence: the rulers brought onyx stones

questions.question: Whom did Moses say the LORD had called by name for the work?
questions.evidence: the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri

questions.question: Which tribe was Bezaleel from?
questions.evidence: of the tribe of Judah

questions.question: Bezaleel's father Uri is called the son of whom?
questions.evidence: Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur

questions.question: Aholiab, who was to teach alongside Bezaleel, is called the son of whom?
questions.evidence: Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

questions.question: Who is named as working alongside Bezaleel on the sanctuary?
questions.evidence: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab

questions.question: What did the workers tell Moses about what the people were bringing?
choices: Only half of what was needed
questions.evidence: The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work

questions.question: What were the curtains for the tent over the tabernacle made of?
questions.evidence: And he made curtains of goats’ hair for the tent over the tabernacle

questions.question: How long was each of the goats' hair curtains?
questions.evidence: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits

questions.question: What kind of wood were the boards for the tabernacle made of?
questions.evidence: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.

questions.question: What were the five sockets of the pillars for the door hanging made of?
questions.evidence: but their five sockets were of brass.

questions.question: Who made the ark in this chapter?
questions.evidence: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood

questions.question: What kind of wood was the ark made of?
questions.evidence: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood

questions.question: The bowls on the candlestick's branches were made after the fashion of what?
questions.evidence: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower

questions.question: How many lamps were made for the candlestick?
questions.evidence: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.

questions.question: How much pure gold was used to make the candlestick and all its vessels?
questions.evidence: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.

questions.question: What was the height of the incense altar?
questions.evidence: and two cubits was the height of it

questions.question: What kind of wood was the altar of burnt offering made of?
questions.evidence: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood

questions.question: From what was the brass laver made?
questions.evidence: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the lookingglasses of the women assembling

questions.question: Who worked with Bezaleel as an engraver and embroiderer?
questions.evidence: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver

questions.question: Which tribe was Bezaleel from?
questions.evidence: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah

questions.question: How many talents of gold were used for the work of the holy place?
questions.evidence: was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels
problems: choice 3 is also supported by the evidence
choice 4 is also supported by the evidence

questions.question: What amount was given for every man who went to be numbered?
questions.evidence: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel

questions.question: How long was the breastplate?
questions.evidence: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof

questions.question: Which stone was the last in the third row of the breastplate?
questions.evidence: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

questions.question: What color was the robe of the ephod made entirely of?
questions.evidence: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

questions.question: What was placed between the pomegranates on the hem of the robe?
questions.evidence: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe

questions.question: What was written on the plate of the holy crown?
questions.evidence: wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.

questions.question: What did Moses do after he looked upon all the finished work?
questions.evidence: and Moses blessed them.

questions.question: Whom was Moses told to bring to the door of the tabernacle and wash with water?
questions.evidence: thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water

questions.question: In which year was the tabernacle reared up?
questions.evidence: in the first month in the second year

questions.question: On which side of the tabernacle did Moses put the table?
questions.evidence: upon the side of the tabernacle northward

questions.question: Along with the burnt offering, what offering did Moses offer on the altar of burnt offering?
questions.evidence: offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering

questions.question: After a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, what filled the tabernacle?
questions.evidence: the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle

questions.question: What was on the tabernacle by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel?
questions.evidence: fire was on it by night
